config.corpus: 2894 accepted papers: 1797 from NeurIPS+ICML 2025, 1097 from NeurIPS+ICML 2024
config.sampling: random with seed 0 from the open proceedings listings of each venue-year
config.design: the two years are independent samples; 2024 is a replication, not a pooled arm
config.extractor: span geometry with vertical-overlap line clustering, caption-anchored tables, typography-derived orientation and direction
config.validation: a second extractor built on pdfplumber grid detection confirms 78.2 percent of values with an error bar; disagreements inspected are mostly the second extractor failing, so that is a lower bound

notes: The central figure replicates to the first decimal place across two independent year samples: 78.0 percent of highlighted comparisons carry no error bar on either side.
